title: Earthily Charred French Stracciatella Cheese Gratin
description: A charred, juicy, solo-dinner French dish featuring stracciatella cheese, fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, and diabetic-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the flavors of Provence with a twist of Asian-inspired rice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cooked fry-grind-rice-khao-khua and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Transfer the rice mixture to a baking dish and top with the shredded stracciatella cheese.
Sprinkle the salt, black pepper, chopped thyme, and lemon zest over the cheese.
Top with the grated parmesan cheese and place under the broiler for 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
